name: @pipeworx/mcp-apollo

tools.name: apollo_search_organizations
tools.description: Requires a PAID Apollo plan (the free plan answers 403). Search Apollo's company database by industry, headcount, HQ location, technologies used, and funding. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey (Settings -> Integrations -> API in the Apollo app). Apollo cost: 1 Apollo credit per page of results (up to 100 results/page), billed to your account. Example: apollo_search_organizations({ industries: ["information technology & services"], employee_ranges: ["11,50"], locations: ["San Francisco, California, US"], _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

q_organization_name.description: Company name, partial match accepted, e.g. "Pipeworx".

industries.description: Industry names, lowercase, exact match per Apollo's own taxonomy, e.g. ["information technology & services"]. Apollo does not publish a fixed enum via this API — look up exact spellings in the Apollo UI's company filter.

industry_tag_ids.description: Apollo industry tag ids, if you already have them (alternative to `industries`).

locations.description: Company HQ locations, e.g. ["San Francisco, California, US"].

technologies.description: Apollo technology UIDs currently in use, e.g. ["salesforce", "hubspot"]. Apollo supports 1,500+ of these; look them up in the Apollo UI's technology filter rather than guessing.

total_funding_min.description: Minimum total funding raised, in dollars.

total_funding_max.description: Maximum total funding raised, in dollars.

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

tools.name: apollo_enrich_organization
tools.description: Enrich a single company by domain, website, or LinkedIn URL: industry, headcount, revenue, funding history, technologies in use, and more. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Apollo cost: 1 Apollo credit per organization enriched. Example: apollo_enrich_organization({ domain: "apollo.io", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

website.description: Full website URL, e.g. "http://www.apollo.io". Alternative to `domain`.

name.description: Company name, to improve match accuracy. Cannot be used alone — pair with domain/website/linkedin_url.

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

tools.name: apollo_search_people
tools.description: Requires a PAID Apollo plan (the free plan answers 403). Search Apollo's people database by job title, seniority, and employer domain/org id. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Apollo cost: 0 credits — but this endpoint returns an OBFUSCATED last name and never an email or phone number; call apollo_enrich_person on a result to resolve a real contact. Example: apollo_search_people({ titles: ["VP of Sales"], seniorities: ["vp"], domains: ["apollo.io"], _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

titles.description: Job titles to match, e.g. ["VP of Sales", "Head of Growth"]. Matches on contained terms too (e.g. "marketing manager" also matches "content marketing manager").

seniorities.description: Apollo seniority levels: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern.

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

tools.name: apollo_enrich_person
tools.description: Requires a PAID Apollo plan (the free plan answers 403). Enrich one specific person by email, LinkedIn URL, or name+domain/organization: title, seniority, department, employer, and (if your account has unlocked it) a work email. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey — this returns data your OWN Apollo licence already covers; Pipeworx caches nothing. Apollo cost: 1 credit if email/demographic data is found, +8 more only for a mobile phone (not requested by this tool, see `note` in the response), 0 if nothing matches. NOT implemented: phone-number reveal (Apollo delivers it asynchronously to a webhook, which this stateless tool call cannot receive). Example: apollo_enrich_person({ name: "Patrick Collison", domain: "stripe.com", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

name.description: Person's full name, e.g. "Patrick Collison". Alternative to first_name+last_name.

organization_name.description: Current or former employer NAME, e.g. "Stripe".

domain.description: Employer domain, e.g. "stripe.com". Helps disambiguate a common name.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Default false. If true, also attempts to reveal a personal (non-work) email, consuming Apollo credit accordingly.

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

tools.name: apollo_org_job_postings
tools.description: List a company's current job postings (title, location, posted/last-seen dates) — a signal for headcount growth in a specific team. BYOK: pass your own Apollo _apiKey. Needs an Apollo `organization_id` (get one from apollo_search_organizations or apollo_enrich_organization first). Apollo cost: 1 Apollo credit per page, up to 10,000 postings total. Example: apollo_org_job_postings({ organization_id: "5e66b6381e05b4008c8331b8", _apiKey: "your-apollo-key" })

organization_id.description: Apollo company id, e.g. from an apollo_search_organizations/apollo_enrich_organization result's `id` field.

_apiKey.description: Your Apollo API key. Get one at https://docs.apollo.io/docs/create-api-key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-apollo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the apollo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
